_doc: One entry per spoken clip in the user's voice file (split at pauses). ¶ = new caption page, §Sx = scene change before the next word, *word* = gold keyword.

segments.text: §S1 ¶If God is real…
why are there *poor* people?
§S2 ¶God answered that question… in a *farming* rule.
¶He told farmers:
¶“When you reap the harvest of your land, ¶you are not to reap to the very *edges* of your field.”
§S3 ¶Leave the corners.
¶“Leave them for the *poor* and the foreigner.”
¶So poor people could always find food.
It was built right into the law.
§S4 ¶And God said:
¶“Open wide your *hand*.”
§S5 ¶Now watch what happened to one poor widow named *Ruth*.
¶Her husband had died. She had no money. And she was a *foreigner*.
§S6 ¶She said:
¶“Please let me go into the fields and *glean* heads of grain.”
§S7 ¶Glean means she picked up the *leftovers*… at the corner of a field.
§S8 ¶But notice. ¶She just happened to pick a field §S9 that belonged to a kind man named *Boaz*.
§S10 ¶Boaz married her. And Ruth became the great-grandmother of King *David*.
§S11 ¶And from David's family came…
*Jesus*.
¶Jesus came from a woman who picked up *leftovers* in a field.
§S12 ¶“Though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became *poor*.”
§S13 ¶And Jesus said:
¶“Whatever you did for one of the least ¶of these brothers of Mine,
you did for *Me*.”
§S14 ¶God’s answer to poverty was always people with *open* hands.
People like you.
§S15 ¶What’s one way you can help someone this week?
One word.
